name: Neon Ridge Media
description: Cinematic storytelling studio behind the sci-fi western series Kade Voss | Bounty Hunter.
descriptionMore: Neon Ridge Media creates cinematic storytelling built for today's audience. The studio's release so far is Kade Voss | Bounty Hunter, an original sci-fi western following bounty hunter Kade Voss across the lawless frontier of the outer systems — outlaws, alien settlements, and forgotten technology.
